title: In-Process Analysis Core Package
summary: Implemented package split and decision record for consuming Quality Studio analysis as an in-process .NET library. The dossier inventories the current solution, defines the stable named-analysis and finding boundary, proves quality-cli as a real caller, answers why the core is useful without the UI, and recommends keeping the core in this repository until explicit extraction criteria are met.

decision.decidedBy: Operator architecture directive recorded in QS-91

responses.question: Is the analysis core useful without the Quality Studio UI?
responses.answer: Yes. Agent Studio pipeline steps, quality-cli, and CI consume the same in-process analysis and Quality Studio finding contracts.

responses.question: Should the core be extracted into its own repository now?
responses.answer: No. Keep it in this repository until release-cadence, external-consumer, version-automation, and public-repository criteria justify the cross-repository cost.
